rule: Loaded 639 rows x 93 cols (intake), 993 rows (members)
reason: starting point

rule: Profile tickets (New / Connected / Flourishing Neighbor Profile) -> profiles file; all other Issue Types -> care-path sub-ticket file
reason: Sub-tickets have no intake fields (housing, income, household all blank for 213/213); they record a service path opened under a parent profile

rule: Sub-tickets whose parent ticket is not in the export kept in sub-ticket file with parent_in_file = No
reason: Parent outside the export window; cannot be linked to a profile

rule: Added pid_matches_parent: sub-ticket PID differs from its parent profile's PID
reason: Same family, two PIDs: shows PID name-matching splits people. Repeat-contact counts based on PID are approximate

rule: Status == 'Duplicate' flagged in is_duplicate_ticket (not removed)
reason: Staff marked these as duplicates; 7 of 12 share a PID with another profile. Teams decide how to handle them

rule: Parsed 'dd/Mon/yy h:mm AM' text to ISO dates; added intake_month
reason: Text dates cannot be sorted or grouped

rule: Added pid_n_profile_tickets, pid_ticket_seq (1 = earliest), pid_is_latest_profile, pid_n_all_tickets (profiles + sub-tickets)
reason: Supports a ticket-level OR person-level analysis unit; PID is name-matched and approximate (see pid_match_basis)

rule: Counted linked care-path sub-tickets per profile: n_care_path_subtickets and sub_<group> counts
reason: Describes services opened AFTER intake; use for profiling/Q11, not as a need feature

rule: Kept first 5 digits of ZIP+4 values (e.g. 40214-5715 -> 40214)
reason: ZIP+4 splits one ZIP into several categories

rule: Non-numeric ZIP '402q1' set to missing
reason: Typo; could be 40211 or 40221 - not guessable

rule: Flagged ZIPs outside Louisville/Jefferson County (e.g. 40107, 40341)
reason: Kept, but likely outside SLCM service area

rule: Trimmed, lower-cased, fixed misspellings (Lousville, Louisvile, Shivley ...), removed trailing 'KY'
reason: 17 spellings -> 5 cities

rule: Dropped: 13 spellings of Kentucky, no analytic value
reason: Constant

rule: Standardised labels; added 6-level housing_group (own-home and temporary categories combined: n = 9, 32)
reason: Very small categories make one-hot columns unstable for clustering

rule: 'Received 7 day notice' (n=2) merged into 'Currently being evicted'
reason: Same stage of the eviction process

rule: Part 1 Figure 2 definition: Yes = currently being evicted OR unhoused; Unknown kept separate from No
reason: Unknown eviction status must not be read as 'not at risk'

rule: Replaced exact court date with has_court_date (Yes/No)
reason: Exact dates add re-identification risk

rule: Flag: any Rent Intake Form field present
reason: Rent fields come from a separate form; blank means 'form not completed', NOT $0 owed (85 'Rent - past due' profiles have no amount)

rule: Implausible pair on one ticket (rent $125,100; past due $242,682; income $0) set to missing, flagged in money_flag
reason: Likely keying error (e.g. 1251.00); value cannot be recovered with confidence

rule: Values >= $10,000 treated as ANNUAL and divided by 12 (24k, 29k, 29k, 30k, 50k, 75k); original kept in income_amount_raw
reason: Field is monthly elsewhere (median $907); these are far outside monthly range

rule: Assignment 3 definition: 1 if past_due_rent >= $3,000, 0 if lower, missing if not recorded
reason: Links Part 2 profiling to Assignment 3

rule: Recomputed from cleaned rent and monthly income (original existed for 93 rows and matched rent/income exactly)
reason: Original used un-annualised income; recomputing keeps it consistent

rule: Values kept but flagged: income $5k-9.9k, rent > $3,000, $0 rent, past-due amount contradicting housing status
reason: Teams decide whether to cap, transform, or exclude; do not delete high values automatically

rule: Two Jira columns combined into income_sources (comma list, as in Assignment 2) and 0/1 indicator columns; Pension/Veterans/Unemployment/Alimony -> inc_src_other
reason: A household can have several sources; one column per source avoids losing the second answer

rule: 'No income' listed together with another source left as reported
reason: Contradictory answer - discuss, don't fix

rule: Combined 4 columns into one list; merged 'Loss of job' into 'Job loss'
reason: Duplicate category wording

rule: Text -> number; 'More than 5' coded as 6 (means 6 or more), flagged in household_flag
reason: Same recoding issue as Moves_Last_3_Years in Assignment 1

rule: Two household sizes kept: adults+children (intake counts) vs 1 + additional members (member roster); disagreement flagged
reason: The two disagree on ~44% of profiles; neither is clearly correct

rule: 0 adults reported flagged (primary contact is an adult)
reason: Staff may have counted only OTHER adults

rule: Ages < 0 or > 100 (e.g. -35, 1806, 1824) set to missing
reason: Impossible; 1806-1824 look like mistyped years

rule: 35 free-text spellings grouped into 6 categories + 'Not recorded'
reason: Free-text field (black / Black / African-American ...)

rule: 28 values grouped into Child / Grandchild / Spouse-partner / Parent / Other relative / Friend-other / Not recorded
reason: Spelling variants (Fiancé/Fiance, Mom/Mother, Esposa)

rule: Added member_row_id (ticket + member #). Member ID repeats across a PID's tickets and can describe different people
reason: e.g. same Member ID with age 3 on one ticket and 23 on another - it is a position, not a person

rule: Joined per-ticket member counts by age group to profiles; has_child_0_5_recorded = Yes / No / Unknown (ages missing)
reason: Only 304 of 426 profiles have a recorded member aged 0-5; worth discussing given the '0-5 population' framing

rule: 4 columns -> goal_* 0/1 indicators (5 common care paths + goal_other) and n_goals; missing when no goal recorded
reason: Rows with no goal recorded are 'unknown', not 'no needs'

rule: Kept 3 health/need indicators. Dropped LGBTQIA+, refugee/immigrant, foster-care, veteran indicators
reason: Sensitive, small counts, re-identification risk; not appropriate clustering inputs. Blank = none selected or not asked

rule: Ages 0 and -1 set to missing
reason: Primary contact must be an adult; likely a child's DOB entered

rule: Fixed Jira label typo 'Black of African American'
reason: Typo

rule: Free text (19 spellings) grouped to English / Spanish / Swahili / Other; bilingual entries -> first language listed
reason: Misspellings (emglish, enhlish, swahli)

rule: Blank -> 'Not recorded' (kept separate from 'No')
reason: Form has no 'none' option; blank cannot be read as 'not behind'

field: Parent summary; Landlord Name; Current Employer; Other Professionals Detail; Comment; Comment.1; Comment.2
rule: Dropped
reason: Possible direct identifiers / free text

field: Summary; Issue id; Resolution; Reporter; Reporter Id; Creator; Creator Id; Updated; Resolved; Watchers; Watchers.1; Watchers Id; Watchers Id.1; Rank; [CHART] Date of First Response; [CHART] Time in Status; Status Category Changed; Parent; Parent key; Labels.1; Labels.2; Labels.3; Labels.4; Labels.5; Labels.6
rule: Dropped
reason: Jira system / staff fields

field: Preferred method of contact; Preferred method of contact.1; Response Method; Response Method.1; Has Email on File; Has Phone on File
rule: Dropped
reason: Contact preferences (no analytic value)

field: State; Pronoun; Insurance Provider for Family; Court Date; Rent-to-Income %
rule: Dropped
reason: Redundant

rule: profiles: 426 rows x 85 cols | sub-tickets: 213 | members: 993 | 426 + 213 = 639 = original 639
reason: Row reconciliation - no rows lost

rule: One row per PID: keep the latest profile ticket (pid_is_latest_profile == Yes)
reason: Earlier tickets set aside, not deleted; they still feed the repeat-contact counts. Avoids counting one household several times

rule: Tickets marked Duplicate are kept and flagged; run without them as a sensitivity check
reason: Staff label is not verified; dropping them would silently change the counts

rule: Unknown kept as its own category
reason: Unknown is not confirmed stability or confirmed risk

rule: log(1 + income); $0 kept as $0
reason: Right-skewed, many true zeros; zero is not missing

rule: Value 6 (top-coded "More than 5") kept as 6
reason: Lower bound; treated as 6 for distances

rule: Missing flags filled with the most frequent value
reason: Only a few people; avoids dropping them

rule: Not used as clustering inputs; used for profiling only
reason: Separate rent form; missing for most profiles (blank is not $0)

rule: Not used as a clustering input; used for profiling only
reason: "Not recorded" cannot be read as "No"

rule: Not used as a clustering input; used for profiling only
reason: Many sparse ZIPs; location is not a need
